A timeline of historical events that have taken place within Jinzhou and Mt. Firmament.

==Pre First Lament==
==Post First Lament==
*During ancient times, [[Jué]] descends upon [[Mt. Firmament]] alongside a colossal vehicle that serves as its hibernation pod. Having sustained serious injuries, the Sentinel loses the ability to restore time, instead only being able to stop and rewind it. <ref>[[Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)]]</ref>

*A large horde of Tacet Discords attack [[Huanglong]]. Hongzhen suffers greatly from this outbreak, so Jué erects a barrier of slowed time around all of Mt. Firmament to protect the people on the island.
**[[Rover]] experiences the placement of this temporal barrier.

==Recent History==
*'''~200 years before LD'''
**Battle of Gorges of Spirits (also called the Fortress and Gorges War)
***Soldiers of Huanglong safeguard their nation against approaching [[Tacet Discord]] in the [[Gorges of Spirits]].<ref>[[Jinzhou Folklore Journal]]</ref> In the midst of the battle, [[Rover|"The First Resonator"]] descends and defeats the [[Crownless]] in combat. Three days later, the army achieves victory, marking the founding of Jinzhou in that same year. <ref>[[Archive: "The First Resonator"]]</ref>
*'''~100 years before LD''' - Rover rescues [[Xuanmiao]] from a TD outbreak. 
*'''~80 years before LD''' - Rover and [[Xuanmiao]] meet again and play a game of Weiqi on Mt. Firmament. They use this game board to set a trap within a Sonoro Sphere for the Fractsidus. The Sonoro Sphere would only activate when Mt. Firmament's flow of time was restored. The only way to escape the Sonoro was to burn it down without injuring anyone within, which Xuanmiao meant as an ultimate test for [[Changli]]. Xuanmiao mentions a new city being established.

==Rover's Departure==
*'''20 years before LD''' — Jinzhou experiences a NovaFei pandemic. The highly contagious disease primarily affects children under six years old, with severe symptoms including fever, limb pain, and muscle atrophy. <ref>[[Archive: Sugar Pearl Vaccine and Tacet Discord Outbreak]]</ref>
**The vaccine is distributed in the form of candy pearls. [[Xiangli Yao]], at 7 months old, is the test subject for this vaccine.
**Rover helps ensure that the vaccine is successfully transported to Jinzhou, defending against Tacet Discord.

*'''10 years before LD''' — The [[Riverside Games]] is won by a 'temporary' team of [[Midnight Rangers]] recruits, including [[Jiyan]], who set a record. A large TD outbreak occurs soon after in [[Desorock Highland]], and due to a shortage of troops, the latest recruits are sent in as reinforcements as a last resort. The majority of them die in the battle, and their frequencies continue to fight for the next decade against merging with the TDs. <ref>[[Daybreak at Last]]</ref>

*'''3 years before LD''' — [[Battle Beneath the Crescent]]
**General [[Geshu Lin]] leads the Midnight Rangers in an attack against Ovathrax, the Threnodian of War. However, Ovathrax enhances the effects of the [[Retroact Rain]] for the first time, causing immense carnage. <ref>[[Rewinding Raindrops]]</ref>
**After issuing a final order for his soldiers not to retreat, Geshu Lin confronts [[Ovathrax]], injuring it but vanishing in the process. [[Jiyan]] leads a retreat with the remaining soldiers.
**Hsi is appointed as the new Magistrate of Jinzhou by [[Jué]], despite being only a teenager, and takes on the name [[Jinhsi]].
**Jiyan is chosen as the new General of the Midnight Rangers by [[Jué]].

*'''<3 years before LD''' — [[Huaxu Academy]] develops an antidote to the [[Retroact Rain]].
